name: Single-Arm Cable Tricep Extension
description: A unilateral tricep isolation exercise performed with a single handle attachment at a high cable pulley. Training each arm independently ensures equal development, identifies strength imbalances, and provides a unique range of motion and angle of resistance compared to bilateral cable extensions.

execution.starting_position: Stand facing a high cable pulley, holding a single handle in one hand. Upper arm close to the body.
execution.setup_instructions: Attach a single handle to the high cable pulley. Grasp it with one hand, palm facing down or inward.
steps: Step 1: Keep the upper arm stationary at your side.
Step 2: Push the handle downward by extending the elbow.
Step 3: Fully extend the elbow at the bottom.
Step 4: Return to the starting position by allowing the elbow to flex.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the extension. Inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Allowing the upper arm to drift forward or backward during the movement
safety_considerations: Keep the upper arm fixed throughout — only the forearm and elbow should move
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension at the bottom. Full flexion at the top.
